I'm a 28-year-old guy from Colombia. Coca grows here like any other crop, so I can easily get free coca leaves in my neighborhood. I usually collect about 200 grams of fresh coca leaves (Erythroxylum novogranatense).
The coca varieties I can get here are novo coca and hybrids, with novo coca being more common than coca. I usually chew coca leaves with baking soda to make them more basic.
These methods of consumption are extremely addictive, and I've had problems with coca leaves in this form. After consumption, I often experience diarrhea, depression, yellow urine, dehydration, anhedonia, and of course, the cocaine crash. Usually, when I chew coca leaves, I start to form a bolus with the leaves and begin to chew them. I swallow my saliva and gag from the oral sedation and the bitter taste of the leaves. However, the effects wear off over time.
I tend to be somewhat compulsive and frequently dose coca leaves in this form. I accompany it with alcohol like wine or beer and cigarettes or tobacco, since they tend to greatly increase the stimulation of the substances. Of course, liver damage is certain.
During the days of chewing, I get a high libido and empathy for other people. I tend to masturbate due to the uncontrollable stimulation, which can lead me to cycles of masturbating for hours in this state.  Coca leaves can be your friend or your enemy.
